node.title: M720 WSL-safe complete zero subcertificates
node.statement: The WSL-safe complete h=7..20 calibration cells selected by the Modal scan ceiling have complete=true and zero unpaid non-toral anchored active cores: n=16,h=7,8 at q~n^2 and q~n^3, and n=32,h=7 at q~n^2 and q~n^3.
